rootCause: BoardForge needed proof that it can repair a deliberately dirty KiCad board into a clean manufacturing candidate, not only generate already-clean synthetic boards.
fixSummary: Create dirty repair fixtures with controlled DRC defects, convert each DRC issue into a transactional mutation task, commit only safe improvements, and gate manufacturing export on DRC 0, ERC errors 0, shorts 0, unconnected 0, and forbidden vias 0.
